시편 4:1.content: To the chief Musician on Neginoth, A Psalm of David. Hear me when I call, O God of my righteousness: thou hast enlarged me when I was in distress; have mercy upon me, and hear my prayer.

시편 4:2.content: O ye sons of men, how long will ye turn my glory into shame? how long will ye love vanity, and seek after leasing? Selah.

시편 4:3.content: But know that the Lord hath set apart him that is godly for himself: the Lord will hear when I call unto him.

시편 4:4.content: Stand in awe, and sin not: commune with your own heart upon your bed, and be still. Selah.

시편 4:5.content: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness, and put your trust in the Lord.

시편 4:6.content: There be many that say, Who will shew us any good? Lord, lift thou up the light of thy countenance upon us.

시편 4:7.content: Thou hast put gladness in my heart, more than in the time that their corn and their wine increased.

시편 4:8.content: I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep: for thou, Lord, only makest me dwell in safety.
